title: Elevated Windows cannot read WSL credential staging paths
summary: Copy smb-l.credentials to C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp before elevated Update-EndpointDriveCredentials; never rely on \\wsl.localhost or /tmp from admin PowerShell.
retrievalQuestions: Why does elevated drive sync fail with WSL credential files unreadable?
ryzen9thumb-drive-sync FATAL no credential source — how to stage creds for admin?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Elevated sync script reports WSL credential files unreadable or FATAL no credential source
runPreflight: Non-elevated: copy WSL cred file to Windows LocalAppData Temp
Elevated: Update-EndpointDriveCredentials.ps1 reads Windows path only
doNot: Pass \\wsl.localhost paths to Start-Process -Verb RunAs scripts
Assume /tmp in WSL is visible to elevated Windows PowerShell
